children: In a market short on fresh triggers, several stocks quietly grabbed attention on October 22, driven by technical breakouts, strong price action, and sustained buying interest.
The selected stocks are showing strong upward momentum, trading well above their key short- to medium-term moving averages, which indicates a positive trend in the near term.

Suraj shares rose 5.80 percent to Rs 209.50, trading above their 30-day moving average of Rs 198.01 and 50-day moving average of Rs 203.10, but below the 150-day moving average of Rs 223.09 and 200-day moving average of Rs 225.12.

Thaai Casting shares rose 5.25 percent to Rs 133.60, trading above all major moving averages, including the 30-day (Rs 126.93), 50-day (Rs 128.90), 150-day (Rs 109.46) and 200-day (Rs 105.56). Trading above all key averages reflects strong upward momentum and a positive long-term technical trend.

GNG Electronics shares rose 5.04 percent to Rs 720.15, trading above all major moving averages, including the 30-day (Rs 685.59), 50-day (Rs 650.00), 150-day (Rs 528.87) and 200-day (Rs 474.86). Trading above all key averages reflects strong upward momentum and a positive long-term technical trend.
The selected stocks are witnessing downward pressure, as reflected in negative price movements and their positioning relative to key moving averages, indicating a cautious market sentiment.

Globale Tessile shares fell 6.74 percent to Rs 10.38, trading below all major moving averages, including the 30-day (Rs 11.13), 50-day (Rs 11.17), 150-day (Rs 11.75) and 200-day (Rs 11.73). Trading below all key averages indicates weak momentum and a negative technical trend.

Tarapur Transformers shares fell 4.39 percent to Rs 12.64, trading below all major moving averages, including the 30-day (Rs 13.22), 50-day (Rs 13.70), 150-day (Rs 18.58) and 200-day (Rs 20.79). Trading below all key averages reflects sustained selling pressure and a weak long-term technical trend.

Visdem Technosys shares fell 4.39 percent to Rs 88.55, trading below their 30-day moving average of Rs 92.62 and 200-day moving average of Rs 90.01, but above the 50-day (Rs 88.35) and 150-day (Rs 85.90) moving averages. The mixed positioning around key averages indicates a lack of clear directional momentum.
International Gemological Institute, Ashapuri Gold Ornament among others were locked in their lower circuits, reflecting strong selling and signalling bullish near-term sentiment.

CreditAccess Gr, MM Financial, SRF, Swiggy, Garden Reach Shipbuilders, Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders, Bombay Burmah, Vishal Mega Mart, UTI AMC, Kama Holdings, SBI Life Insurance, Avenue Supermarts, Power Grid Corporation, Max Healthcare, NAVA, TMPV, Finolex Industries, Lupin, Colgate-Palmolive and Fortis Healthcare were among others hit 52-week low.

title: Momentum Stocks: Globale Tessile, Tarapur Transformers, Visdem Technosys under pressure, down up to 6%
